---
title: "Pair Blocks within Loci"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_pairing            <- file.path(currentdir, "07_pairing")
outdir_pairing_candidates <- file.path(outdir_pairing, "01_candidates")
outdir_pairing_mafftadd   <- file.path(outdir_pairing, "02_mafftadd")
outdir_pairing_epa_ng     <- file.path(outdir_pairing, "03_epa_ng")
sapply(c(outdir_pairing_candidates, outdir_pairing_mafftadd, outdir_pairing_epa_ng), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})
```

```{r pairing-candidates}
# read the block assignments
df_blocks_all    <- data.table::fread(file.path(outdir_assignment, "block_assignments.tsv"))
df_blocks_all$PS <- as.character(df_blocks_all$PS)

# extract the list of loci
ls_locus <- list.files(outdir_blocks_cds, pattern="_filtered\\.fna$", recursive=F, full.names=F)
ls_locus <- gsub("_filtered\\.fna$", "", ls_locus)

# iterate over loci
ls_anchor <- lapply(ls_locus, function(locus) {
    # open the alignment file
    block_cds <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(file.path(outdir_blocks_cds, paste0(locus, "_filtered.fna")))

    # extract all h1 CDS blocks
    is_h1     <- grepl("_h1$", names(block_cds))

    # extract the number of valid sites per block
    n_sites   <- Biostrings::width(block_cds)[is_h1]
    n_invalid <- Biostrings::letterFrequency(block_cds[is_h1], letters="Nn")[, 1]
    df_sites  <- data.frame(PS      = gsub(".*_PS([^_]+)_h1$", "\\1", names(block_cds)[is_h1]),
                            n_valid = n_sites - n_invalid)

    # merge data.frames based on PS
    df_blocks <- merge(df_sites, df_blocks_all[df_blocks_all$locus == locus, c("PS", "tier", "decision")],
                       by="PS", all.x=TRUE)

    # categories all NAs to be "none" and "ambiguous"
    df_blocks$tier[is.na(df_blocks$tier)]         <- "none"
    df_blocks$decision[is.na(df_blocks$decision)] <- "ambiguous"

    # if there is only one CDS block, skip selection
    if (nrow(df_blocks) < 2) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    # select the anchor block
    df_blocks <- df_blocks[order(match(df_blocks$tier, c("both", "single", "none")), -df_blocks$n_valid), ]
    if (df_blocks$tier[1] == "none") {
        return(NULL)
    }
    anchor_PS <- df_blocks$PS[1]

    # write the candidate sequences
    seq_candidates <- f_pairing_candidates(block_cds, locus, anchor_PS, df_blocks$PS[-1])
    Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq_candidates, filepath=file.path(outdir_pairing_candidates, paste0(locus, ".fna")))

    # return data.frame
    data.table::data.table(locus           = locus,
                           anchor_PS       = anchor_PS,
                           anchor_tier     = df_blocks$tier[1],
                           anchor_decision = df_blocks$decision[1],
                           anchor_n_valid  = df_blocks$n_valid[1],
                           n_blocks        = nrow(df_blocks))
})

# save the anchors
df_anchor <- data.table::rbindlist(ls_anchor)
data.table::fwrite(df_anchor, file=file.path(outdir_pairing, "anchors.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# update the log file
log4r::info(fn_logger, paste0("Block pairing: ", nrow(df_anchor), " loci with an anchor",
                              " (both-tier: ", sum(df_anchor$anchor_tier == "both"), ", ",
                              "single-tier: ", sum(df_anchor$anchor_tier == "single"), "); ",
                              sum(df_anchor$n_blocks) - nrow(df_anchor), " blocks to pair"))
```

```{r pairing-placement}
# open the best model for each gene tree
df_genetree_model <- data.table::fread(params$file_backbone_genetree_models)

# create doSNOW cluster
nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

# iterate over loci with candidates
foreach (locus = df_anchor$locus) %dopar% {
    # input files
    fn_query    <- file.path(outdir_pairing_candidates, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
    fn_ref      <- file.path(params$dir_backbone_alignment, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
    fn_ref_tree <- file.path(params$dir_backbone_genetrees, paste0(locus, ".treefile"))
    if (!all(file.exists(fn_query, fn_ref, fn_ref_tree))) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    # MAFFT --add
    fn_output_alignment <- file.path(outdir_pairing_mafftadd, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
    f_mafft_add(fn_ref    = fn_ref,
                fn_sample = fn_query,
                fn_out    = fn_output_alignment,
                exe_mafft = params$exe_mafft)

    # remove '_R_' for reverse-complemented sequence
    aln <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(fn_output_alignment)
    names(aln) <- gsub("^_R_", "", names(aln))
    Biostrings::writeXStringSet(aln, filepath=fn_output_alignment)

    # split the reference and query sequences for EPA-NG
    dir_output <- file.path(outdir_pairing_epa_ng, locus)
    if (!dir.exists(dir_output)) {
        dir.create(dir_output, recursive=T)
    }

    fn_epa_ng_log <- file.path(dir_output, paste0(locus, ".log"))
    system(paste(params$exe_epa_ng, "--split", fn_ref, fn_output_alignment, "-w", dir_output, ">>", fn_epa_ng_log))

    # place the candidates on the gene tree
    substitution_model <- f_iqtree2epa_ng_model(df_genetree_model$model[df_genetree_model$locus==locus])
    if (is.null(substitution_model)) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    f_epa_ng(fn_ref     = file.path(dir_output, "reference.fasta"),
             fn_query   = file.path(dir_output, "query.fasta"),
             fn_tree    = fn_ref_tree,
             model      = substitution_model,
             outdir     = dir_output,
             fn_log     = fn_epa_ng_log,
             exe_epa_ng = params$exe_epa_ng)

    # translate placements into lineage name
    f_gappa_assign(fn_jplace = file.path(dir_output, "epa_result.jplace"),
                   fn_taxon  = params$file_taxonomy_metadata,
                   threshold = params$min_consensus_thresh,
                   outdir    = file.path(dir_output, "assign"),
                   log_file  = fn_epa_ng_log,
                   exe_gappa = params$exe_gappa)
}

stopCluster(nwcl)
```

```{r pairing-decision}
# iterate over loci with candidates
ls_pairings <- lapply(df_anchor$locus, function(locus) {
    # check input files
    fn_jplace    <- file.path(outdir_pairing_epa_ng, locus, "epa_result.jplace")
    fn_per_query <- file.path(outdir_pairing_epa_ng, locus, "assign", "per_query.tsv")
    if (!all(file.exists(fn_jplace, fn_per_query))) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    # merge the two data.frames
    df <- as.data.frame(merge(f_read_jplace_likelihood(fn_jplace),
                              f_read_gappa_rank(fn_per_query, params$taxonomy_rank), by="name", all.x=TRUE))

    # parse the candidate names: <locus>_A<anchor>[I|II]_PS<block>_h[12]
    tag        <- sub("^.*_A([^_]+)_PS.*$", "\\1", df$name)
    df$pairing <- sub("^[0-9]+", "", tag)
    df$PS      <- sub("^.*_PS([^_]+)_h[12]$", "\\1", df$name)
    df$hap     <- sub("^.*_(h[12])$", "\\1", df$name)

    # anchor alone
    a1 <- df[df$pairing == "" & df$hap == "h1", ]
    a2 <- df[df$pairing == "" & df$hap == "h2", ]

    # iterate over blocks
    ls_blocks <- lapply(unique(df$PS[df$pairing != ""]), function(ps) {
        # subset the data.frame with the respective PS
        x   <- df[df$PS == ps, ]

        # function: subset data.frame
        subset_df <- function(pairing, hap) {
            x[x$pairing == pairing & x$hap == hap, ]
        }

        # check if any haplotype does not exist
        if (any(sapply(list(subset_df("I", "h1"), subset_df("I", "h2"), subset_df("II", "h1"), subset_df("II", "h2")), nrow) != 1)) {
            return(NULL)
        }

        # extract delta log-likelihood between the two configurations
        dLL <- (subset_df("I", "h1")$loglik + subset_df("I", "h2")$loglik) - (subset_df("II", "h1")$loglik + subset_df("II", "h2")$loglik)

        # extract the probability that a configuration is favoured
        P   <- 1 / (1 + exp(-dLL))
        pairing <- ifelse(P >= params$min_alwr, "I", ifelse(P <= 1 - params$min_alwr, "II", "none"))

        # function: compare lineages from two configurations
        keeps_lineage <- function(a, y) {
            is.na(a$lineage) || a$aLWR < params$min_alwr || (!is.na(y$lineage) && y$lineage == a$lineage && y$aLWR >= params$min_alwr)
        }

        # compare each configuration with the anchor-only
        if (pairing == "none") {
            y1 <- data.frame(lineage=NA, aLWR=NA)
            y2 <- y1
        } else {
            y1 <- subset_df(pairing, "h1")
            y2 <- subset_df(pairing, "h2")
        }
        accepted <- pairing != "none" && keeps_lineage(a1, y1) && keeps_lineage(a2, y2)

        # return output data.frame
        data.table::data.table(locus = locus, anchor_PS = a1$PS, PS = ps, dLL = round(dLL, 3), P = round(P, 4), pairing = pairing,
                               h1_lineage_anchor = a1$lineage, h1_aLWR_anchor = round(a1$aLWR, 4),
                               h2_lineage_anchor = a2$lineage, h2_aLWR_anchor = round(a2$aLWR, 4),
                               h1_lineage_paired = y1$lineage, h1_aLWR_paired = round(y1$aLWR, 4),
                               h2_lineage_paired = y2$lineage, h2_aLWR_paired = round(y2$aLWR, 4),
                               accepted = accepted)
    })
    data.table::rbindlist(ls_blocks)
})

# combine with the anchor decisions and save
df_pairings <- data.table::rbindlist(ls_pairings)
df_pairings <- merge(df_pairings, df_anchor[, c("locus", "anchor_tier", "anchor_decision")], by="locus")
data.table::fwrite(df_pairings, file=file.path(outdir_pairing, "block_pairings.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# update the log file
readr::write_lines(c("", paste0("Block pairing: ", nrow(df_pairings), " blocks tested, ",
                                sum(df_pairings$pairing != "none"), " with a pairing (P >= ", params$min_alwr, "), ",
                                sum(df_pairings$accepted), " accepted after the lineage check")),
                   file=fn_log, append=T)
```
